label: Pop-up
purpose: A link that opens an existing store page (e.g. size guide, shipping info) in a popup
_notes: text is the clickable link label (e.g. 'Size Guide', 'Shipping & Returns'). The 'page' setting (which Shopify page's content is shown in the popup) is intentionally excluded — it references a specific page the merchant has already created and the AI has no way to know its handle, so it should be left to the merchant/theme editor. close_button_style is purely visual and excluded.
